sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, though they've won only one of their last two outings. Alsager arrive in poor form and sit bottom of the division with just 4 points, having won only once all season, so this should present Sandbach with a favourable opportunity to return to winning ways.
divisionWide: Second-place Stafford Town face fellow promotion contenders in a tricky away trip to Dawley Town (15:00), with Stafford level on points with third-placed AFC Bridgnorth but having played two more games. Eccleshall host AFC Bridgnorth in a direct clash between third and fifth, with Bridgnorth in excellent recent form despite their most recent loss. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a mid-table encounter, while Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) welcome Foley Meir at home. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a bottom-half fixture with both teams struggling for consistency. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a particularly low-scoring battle between two teams with severe goal-difference problems. Crewe host Allscott Heath, a match between mid-table sides, while Brereton Social face Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points) at home—Widnes remain pointless in their last five games. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, with Shawbury on a concerning run of five consecutive defeats.
